votes.motion: Approve the request for use of an I/A system at 14 Asplund.
votes.quote: after discussion and motion by rudd and second by fortin, the request was approved.

votes.motion: Accept the water test results for 27 Fire Road 15A as potable.
votes.quote: after discussion and on motion by pirro and second by jewell, the board accepted the water test results as potable.

votes.motion: Allow the second well at 757 Chase Road to remain, completely disconnected from service, and return to the board before any future use.
votes.quote: after discussion, and on motion by jewell and second by fortin, the board voted to allow the 2nd well to exist on the property

votes.motion: Allow up to $50,000 from the grant fund to bring the septic system at 30 School Street back into working order. No motion or second is recorded for this vote.
votes.quote: the board voted to allow up to $50,000 from the grant fund to be used to bring the septic system back up to working.

votes.motion: Approve the change in use of the septic system at 30 School Street to civic and/or community use, and site plan approval before the Planning Board.
votes.quote: on motion by fortin and second by rudd, the change in use and site plan approval approved.

votes.motion: Approve the variances requested for 141 Pleasant Street: use of an I/A system, reduction of cellar wall distance from 20 feet to 11 feet, wetlands offset from 50 feet to 25 feet, and use of sieve analysis.
votes.quote: after discussion an on motion by pirro and second by jewell, the variances were approved.
